cheatSheets: For operations with storage, prefer use mode:"ai" with aiPrompt; forceChanges optional
For simple and predicted operations with storage, use storage without ai mode
If you need to modify storage somehow, use storage with ai mode instead of agent node + storage node
Storage fields access: {{ storage.fieldName }} or {{ fieldName }}
Use forceChanges: true to require at least one operation in ai mode
AI prompts: be specific about when NOT to update (avoid unnecessary operations)
Use formatData for pretty-printing existing storage in AI prompts
Include clear business rules for calculations in AI prompts
Structure data with metadata fields for better filtering and correlation
Do not put current storage in aiPrompt, it will be provided automatically
Storage schema if available also will be provided automatically in context
Try to do not use timestamps (and time at all) in storage
Sort arrays: op:"sort", path:"items", field:"rating", order:"desc" (asc/desc)
Update by filter: op:"update_by_filter", path:"items", filter:{id:"x"}, value:{field:newVal}
Remove by index: op:"remove", path:"deck", value:"{{ cardIndex }}" or value:0
Remove by filter: op:"remove", path:"deck", filter:{name:"{{ drawnCard.name }}"}
Bracket notation supported: path:"items[0].name" same as "items.0.name"

cheatSheets: UI nodes should be only connected with UI entrypoints, not after storage node and not in the middle/end of workflow started from entrypoints different from UI entrypoint
For ui, use templates[], include per-template placement, set outputAs (and returnValue if needed)
If ANY node has type "ui", you MUST set entryPoints.UI_REQUEST to that ui node id
UI template config uses {{...}} with item/index available (e.g., {{item}}, {{index}}, {{storage.field}})
In chat messages you cant inject images using markdown, use imageGeneration node instead
Use above_input for short-lived suggestions; set ttl (e.g., 120–300s) to auto-expire
Use sidebar for status/progress; avoid frequent re-renders to reduce churn
Prefer stable IDs (e.g., id: "btn-{{item.id}}") to help the client deduplicate
Dynamic colors with conditionals: "{{value > 50 ? '#green' : value > 20 ? '#yellow' : '#red'}}"
Placement should be set once in template, not duplicated

Never print whole body from storage into UI content component. You need to format it. This is bad idea: "content": "{{storage.shelfDisplay}}" Use functions to iterate over array of objects and format them
Use disabled property for buttons/checkboxes/select options: disabled: "{{storage.isLocked}}" or disabled: true

IMPORTANT: UI components are generated once when UI_REQUEST entrypoint is called. To update disabled state after storage changes, use refresh node after storage updates, or frontend must listen to ui_components_updated WebSocket event and re-fetch UI components
